description: This is a Java source file defining the MetricService class, which provides methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to performance metrics within a project. It interacts with a repository layer and manages performance metric entities, including listing and trend analysis.

classes.name: MetricService
classes.description: Service managing performance metrics and chart data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new performance metric record based on the provided request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing metric identified by its ID with data from the request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a metric record specified by its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a performance metric by its ID.

methods.name: listByEmployee
methods.description: Lists all metrics for a specific employee, sorted by timestamp.

methods.name: listByEmployeeAndType
methods.description: Lists metrics filtered by employee ID and metric type, sorted by timestamp.

methods.name: getTrendWindow
methods.description: Provides a list of metrics within a specified number of days, used for trend analysis.
